summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen and Tom Kelly would spar the wind-up at the Union Club's July 4 tournament at the Union Base-Ball Grounds, and would supervise most of the arrangements.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, June 28, 1884

facts.fact: Allen was billed to spar the wind-up with Tom Kelly, ex-middleweight champion, at the Union Club's Fourth of July tournament, both in full ring costume, for the Union Club Cup
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, St. Louis

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly supervised the arrangements for the Union Club's July 4 athletic tournament, apart from Bill Richards' handicapping
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, St. Louis
